title: Anticipatory Commonsense with Moving Objects: An ASP-Based Framework for Predictive Reasoning with Interacting Trajectories
abstract: arXiv:2610.20867v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present a general declarative framework for anticipatory reasoning about interactive motion in complex dynamic environments. Our focus is on (explainable) anticipatory space-time mental model formation at a semantic level to heuristically guide low-level motion computation. Our method is hybrid, modular and elaboration tolerant integrating: 1) An ASP model characterising the dynamics of interactive motion trajectories; 2) Semantically-guided prediction for deriving `branching trajectory futures'; and 3) An energy-based {optimisation} model to evaluate, rank and filter anticipations. We evaluate with the Argoverse 2 benchmark, where each anticipated trajectory carries an explicit, inspectable event-level hypothesis, unlike end-to-end stochastic prediction.

translated_title: 移动物体的前瞻性常识推理：一个基于ASP的交互轨迹预测推理框架
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一个通用的声明式框架，用于对复杂动态环境中的交互运动进行前瞻性推理。我们的重点是在语义层面形成（可解释的）前瞻性时空心智模型，以启发式地引导低层运动计算。我们的方法是混合式、模块化且可细化的，整合了三个部分：1）一个刻画交互运动轨迹动态特性的ASP（回答集编程）模型；2）用于推导“分支轨迹未来”的语义引导预测；3）一个基于能量的优化模型，用于评估、排序和筛选前瞻性结果。我们在Argoverse 2基准数据集上进行了评估，与端到端的随机预测不同，每条预测轨迹都带有明确的、可检查的事件级假设。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个基于ASP的混合声明式框架，通过结合交互轨迹动态建模、语义引导的分支未来预测和基于能量的优化评估，实现了对复杂动态环境中交互运动的可解释前瞻性推理，每条预测轨迹均携带可检查的事件级假设。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a hybrid ASP-based declarative framework that integrates interactive trajectory dynamics modeling, semantically-guided branching future prediction, and energy-based optimization to enable explainable anticipatory reasoning about interacting motions in complex dynamic environments, with each predicted trajectory carrying an explicit, inspectable event-level hypothesis.
